tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Page background: an airy, barely warm white. Ink, ink-muted and link read on it.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: White panels that sit on a yellow band or a tint: chat panes, dialogs, the browser mockup. Ink, ink-muted and link read on it.

tokens.name: surface-300
tokens.usage: The pale yellow wash that separates things without a line: cards, rows, chat panes on white pages, table stripes. Ink, ink-muted and link read on it.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body and heading text on every surface, including misha. Ink-filled buttons on yellow bands.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and timestamps on surface-100, surface-200, surface-300, misha-tint and misha.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on ink fills (the button on a yellow band).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: a 3px solid outline with a 3px offset, on every control (chips included). It is an outline, not a border, and reads at 3:1 or better on every surface.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: The backdrop behind a dialog or a bottom sheet: ink at 40%. Nothing else uses it.

tokens.name: misha
tokens.usage: The main colour. Full-bleed bands (hero, the limits, the pilot page), the account rail, primary buttons, the mascot. Always carries ink (on-misha); never used as text.

tokens.name: misha-deep
tokens.usage: Hover fill for primary buttons and the highlight under a link. Carries on-misha text.

tokens.name: misha-tint
tokens.usage: A lighter yellow for fields, placeholders, the terminal, the current item in a list, the hover fill of pale controls and the 'work' status pill. Ink and ink-muted read on it.

tokens.name: on-misha
tokens.usage: Text and icons on misha, misha-deep and misha-tint.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links on white and pale surfaces. On a yellow band, links are ink and underlined instead.

tokens.name: status-ok
tokens.usage: Text and icon of a 'connected' or 'done' status, on status-ok-tint, surface-200 and surface-300. Blue-teal, not green, so it never leans on red against green.

tokens.name: status-ok-tint
tokens.usage: Fill behind a 'connected' or 'done' status.

tokens.name: status-wait
tokens.usage: Text and icon of a 'waiting' or 'needs attention' status (waiting for admin approval, needs reconnecting, not enough access), on status-wait-tint, surface-200 and surface-300.

tokens.name: status-wait-tint
tokens.usage: Fill behind a 'waiting' or 'needs attention' status. A peach, so it can't be mistaken for the yellow.

tokens.name: status-bad
tokens.usage: Text and icon of a 'denied', 'cancelled', 'failed' or 'not working' status, on status-bad-tint, surface-200 and surface-300. Always with a word and an icon.

tokens.name: status-bad-tint
tokens.usage: Fill behind a 'denied', 'cancelled' or 'failed' status, and the destructive confirmation.

tokens.name: cactus
tokens.usage: The 🌵 gag only. A mark, not a status; never a success colour.

tokens.name: term-bg
tokens.usage: Terminal window ground: the terminal is light too.

tokens.name: term-bar
tokens.usage: Terminal title bar fill. Text on it is term-dim or term-fg.

tokens.name: term-fg
tokens.usage: Terminal text on term-bg.

tokens.name: term-dim
tokens.usage: Terminal secondary text and timestamps on term-bg and term-bar.

tokens.name: term-prompt
tokens.usage: Terminal prompt character and ticket keys on term-bg.

tokens.name: term-ok
tokens.usage: Terminal 'done' lines on term-bg. Always followed by the word 'done'.

tokens.name: term-wait
tokens.usage: Terminal 'waiting for you' lines on term-bg. Always followed by the words 'waiting for your answer'.

tokens.name: term-bad
tokens.usage: Terminal errors on term-bg.

families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The landing hero headline and, once more, the closing 'Want in?'. Nothing else.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Page titles: docs, pricing, security, legal, and the sign-in and result pages.

styles.name: heading-1
styles.usage: Section headings and web app page titles.

styles.name: heading-2
styles.usage: Card titles, dialog titles, big FAQ and result headings.

styles.name: heading-3
styles.usage: Small titles: steps, list groups, connections.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Inline emphasis, labels in the clone's messages.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Helper text under titles, table notes.

styles.name: code-sm
styles.usage: Inline code in small text, design notes.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Small label above a heading. Set uppercase with 0.08em tracking.

styles.name: scribble
styles.usage: Dumdum Misha's own notes on the page: one short line, first person, at most one per section. Never for trust, billing or permission copy.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a status icon and its word.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between tightly related controls; list row padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between controls in a row; field label to field.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default stack gap; padding of compact panels.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between rows and between a card's parts.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between columns.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Page and panel padding; gap between a heading and its block.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Large gaps; the airy default between page blocks.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Band padding, top and bottom.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Space below the hero; rare, generous.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything is square: buttons, panels, fields, pills, avatars. The mascot is the only rounded thing.

tokens.name: tilt-1
tokens.usage: A barely crooked panel, number or card. The 'good enough' tilt. Never on a pane that holds a clone message.

tokens.name: tilt-2
tokens.usage: A clearly crooked sticker or numeral, tilting the other way.

tokens.name: tilt-3
tokens.usage: Hand-written notes (scribble).

tokens.name: tilt-4
tokens.usage: The mascot's own lean, and every peek that comes in from an edge (hero, closing call, account rail).

tokens.name: size-content
tokens.usage: Maximum width of marketing page content.

tokens.name: size-reading
tokens.usage: Maximum width of paragraphs in docs and legal articles. Used there only.

tokens.name: size-emoji
tokens.usage: The marker emoji's design size: it has to read here. Web chat panes set it at 20px, Slack's own inline size.

tokens.name: size-avatar
tokens.usage: Avatar in a chat message.

tokens.name: size-lead
tokens.usage: Maximum width of a section head and of an FAQ answer.

tokens.name: size-panel
tokens.usage: Maximum width of a centred panel: the sign-in panel and the result pages.

tokens.name: size-app
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the main column in the account app.
